session.description: Values refer to live physics, not source authoring. Group prim lists define membership; static capability does not guarantee live admission. Existing session ownership, synchronization and failure semantics apply.

directgpu_warmup.description: Device-backed DirectGPU state requires a completed first step; a write never warms the simulation automatically.

rigid_velocity.description: On CPU/readback, standalone kinematic velocity setters fail; other rows may already have been written. DirectGPU has different setter support.

kinematic_target.description: Writing requires standalone kinematic bodies on CPU/readback; DirectGPU and articulation-link writes are refused. Reads fall back to current pose without a target.

wake.description: Wake/sleep applies to the whole articulation or standalone body. DirectGPU refuses this CPU-side command.

joint_limit.description: Finite limits require limited axes; changing a free axis to limited requires structural authoring. Invalid conditions reject before mutation.

vehicle.description: Vehicles are unavailable on DirectGPU. Controls require compatible drive/chassis state and finite accepted values; writes preflight the group before mutation. Telemetry may omit incompatible rows.

raw_wheel.description: Only vehicles without a managed drive accept raw-wheel controls. Commands persist until replaced; invalid controls reject before mutation.

deformable.description: Simulation-node state requires a CUDA context; no corresponding CPU simulation. Read membership follows available simulation meshes.

skin_mesh.description: Skinned vertices require a CUDA context; skinning is a GPU post-solve step with no CPU twin. Read membership follows skin meshes with skinned vertices, scoped by the owning body.

volume_target.description: Volume nodes only; incompatible pre-existing kinematic control is refused, and a pinned node cannot be freed: it keeps its last target and an error is logged. w=0 drives the node; nonzero w leaves it free.

surface_material.description: Bending and thickness exist only on concrete surface materials; volume materials contribute no row.

contact_filters.description: Requires a contact query with filters; element ordering and companion counts identify each filter partition.

contact_events.description: CPU/readback contact event data only; DirectGPU events are unsupported. Per-event counts partition point and anchor arrays.

cct_move.description: Finite world displacement executes once at commit on CPU/readback. The caller supplies gravity or grounding displacement; repeated zero moves do not guarantee sustained following of a moving platform. DirectGPU is refused; backing rigid pose changes on the next simulation step.

native_pointer.description: Borrowed native address, valid only while the object remains alive. Does not confer ownership or bypass runtime synchronization. Structural changes (adding, removing or re-inserting objects, moving them between scenes, attaching or detaching shapes) through a native PhysX pointer are not recommended: after one, ovphysx reads and writes are not guaranteed to work until the stage is re-attached.

debug.description: Instance-level target, available without a stage. Scope uses dictionary-owned path tokens; settings persist, geometry is read-only. Scope and cullingBox have asymmetric read/write encodings.
